name: Shui Shi Beigao Ren - Linghun Hui Shi
source:
"Who is the Defendant" is a mystery genre visual novel. Players take on the role of a prosecutor, investigating a case involving "a game with rudimentary art published on STEAM."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988880/]Steam[/url]]
